task_fulfillment.rationale: The Word deliverable substantially addresses sincere engagement, negotiation levers, tooling, scenarios, BATNA and localisation milestones. It is not yet a dependable continuity guide: bridge feasibility relies on unconfirmed capacity, component and timing assumptions; the immediate-stop case is missing; and shortage exceptions do not quantify how production is maintained. Advance-payment offers also need reconciliation with the payment red line. No companion files were supplied. Page count and rendering remain unverified and are not grounds for this failure; checklist formatting alone is also not grounds.
